Fertiliser Subsidy May Rise to ₹2.5 Lakh Crore in FY27

The Fertiliser Association of India (FAI) estimates that the fertiliser subsidy for the fiscal year 2027 (FY27) could increase to ₹2.5 lakh crore, significantly exceeding the budgeted amount of ₹1.71 lakh crore. FAI chairman suggested that a potential fall in urea prices might mitigate the impact of this subsidy increase.
